description: Set who answers a customer's text conversation. owner 'ai' (the default): Kai replies. 'human': Kai stays quiet and the business owner answers. 'external': Kai stays quiet and the business's own system answers; it receives the sms.received webhook and replies with send_message or POST /v1/messages. With external_reply_timeout_seconds (external only, 60 to 86400), Kai answers a message nothing replied to in that time. Messages are always stored and sms.received always fires. Pass conversation_id for one conversation, or phone for every conversation the business has with that customer. Re-sending the same owner changes nothing.

business_id.description: Required when the account has more than one business and only phone is given.

conversation_id.description: One conversation. Either this or phone is required.

external_reply_timeout_seconds.description: owner 'external' only: Kai answers when nothing replied in this many seconds.

phone.description: The customer's number (E.164): every conversation the business has with it.

name: set_conversation_owner
title: Set Conversation Owner
